    • scrollProcessInstances

      public ProcessInstanceScrollDTO scrollProcessInstances(PagedRequestDTO filterDTO, int from, int toExclusive, LoggedInUserContext userContext)
      Scrolls process instances by offset range over the filtered, sorted sequence (half-open interval [from, to)).

      Does not compute a total matching count (no count query): hasNext is derived by fetching one extra row past the requested window.

      public void cancelInstancesBatch(io.telekom.orchest.api.core.request.BatchInstanceRequest request)
      Cancels multiple process instances by ID. Caller must validate request (non-empty, max 500 IDs) before invoking. Async dispatch is handled by the reactive controller via Schedulers.boundedElastic().
